data_objects.name: weather_time_series
data_objects.meaning: Chronological weather measurements containing thermal, humidity, wind, visibility, pressure, and sun-related fields.

variables.name: time
variables.meaning: Observation timestamp encoded as an ISO-style UTC date-time string.

variables.name: wind direction
variables.meaning: Categorical compass-direction code for wind direction.

structure.description: Each row is a weather observation at one time, and rows are chronologically ordered by the UTC timestamp.

uncertainties: Measurement units are not stated for sun, temperature, chill, humidity, wind speed, visibility, or air pressure.
The definition of sun and the vocabulary used by the wind-direction codes are not documented.
annotation_notes: The timestamp encoding and weather roles are visible in train.csv; undocumented units remain null.
